weathermod.configuration.blockBudgetPerT: Maximum number of blocks one storm may rip out of the ground per tick.
weathermod.configuration.builtInYearLeng: Length of the built-in seasonal year in game days; each season takes a quarter of it. 0 disables the built-in seasons. Ignored when Serene Seasons is installed.
weathermod.configuration.debugOverlay.to: Show the weather debug overlay with wind and storm list in the top-left corner. Can also be toggled with the overlay key.
weathermod.configuration.depositionBlock: Positions each precipitation storm tries to lay snow or ice on per tick. 0 disables deposition, higher values build snow faster at more server cost.
weathermod.configuration.destructionMode: How much storms may change the world. Full rips blocks and moves entities, Entities Only moves entities but never rips or throws blocks, Visual Only touches nothing. Snow and ice deposition follow their own toggles and are disabled only by Visual Only.
weathermod.configuration.enabledDimensio: Dimensions in which the weather simulation runs, as resource locations such as minecraft:overworld. An empty list disables weather everywhere.
weathermod.configuration.endStormsOnSlee: End the precipitation storms covering players who sleep through the night, as vanilla ends its rain. The storms ramp down instead of vanishing at once.
weathermod.configuration.fantasyPackEnab: Allow weather types from the fantasy family, such as blood rain and meteor showers, to spawn naturally.
weathermod.configuration.hazeStrength.to: Multiplier on fog and haze thickness caused by storms. 0.0 disables the fog enhancer.
weathermod.configuration.iceFormation.to: Let snow storms freeze still water under them into ice. Ignored while the destruction mode is Visual Only.
weathermod.configuration.maxFlyingBlocks: Maximum number of flying block entities a single storm may have in the air at once. 0 destroys ripped blocks instead of throwing them.
weathermod.configuration.maxStormsPerDim: Maximum number of storms that may exist at the same time in one dimension.
weathermod.configuration.naturalSpawnInt: Real seconds between the storm director's natural spawn attempts at a storm frequency of 1.0. Each wait is divided by the frequency and varied by up to half either way.
weathermod.configuration.particleDensity: Multiplier on the number of rain, snow, dust and debris particles. 0.0 disables them, 2.0 doubles them.
weathermod.configuration.severeWeatherCo: Real seconds that must pass after a severe storm ends before another may form in the same dimension.
weathermod.configuration.snowAccumulatio: Let snow storms lay snow layers on the ground under them, up to the snowAccumulationHeight game rule. Ignored while the destruction mode is Visual Only.
weathermod.configuration.soundVolume.too: Volume of wind, rain and storm sounds played by the mod, on top of the game's weather volume.
weathermod.configuration.stormDriftFacto: Fraction of the wind speed at which storms travel. 1.0 carries a 128-block rain storm past a player in under a minute; 0.3 gives a few minutes of rain.
Multiplier on how often storms form naturally. 1.0 is the designed rate, 0.0 disables natural storms.
weathermod.configuration.syncIntervalTic: Ticks between storm update packets sent to nearby players. Lower is smoother but uses more bandwidth.
weathermod.configuration.title: %s Configuration
weathermod.configuration.vanillaWeatherB: Keep vanilla rain and thunder in step with the mod's storms: vanilla rains while a precipitation storm covers a player and is dry otherwise, so crops, cauldrons and fishing respond. Off leaves the vanilla weather cycle alone.
